resources.string: Returns you to your Zen screen when you open an app you chose to block

Zen Mode uses accessibility access for one purpose: to notice which app is in the foreground while a Zen session is running, so it can bring you back to your Zen screen if you open an app you chose to block.

It reads only the name of the app in front. It cannot read your screen, your messages, or anything you type. Nothing is recorded and nothing leaves your phone.

It does nothing when no session is running, and never interrupts the phone dialer, Android settings, your launcher or the system interface. You can turn it off here at any time; Zen Mode keeps working without it, just without app blocking.
A quiet, ongoing notification while a Zen session is running
Tells you when a Zen session has finished
Keeps a user-started focus session running and visible, and ends it on time
